GitHub #1491 reports Git add/add conflicts for an item and its history when the Git merge base lacks those files but both sides contain a copied creation/history prefix. Git reports AA while working files remain a marker-free preferred side; staging that file can discard the other branch from the resolved snapshot. The reporter supplies a minimal real-Git cherry-pick reproduction on published 2026.10.17. This delivery has not independently reproduced the case.

Preserve the completed creation-ancestry protections in pm-qx95lz and the structured merge-driver safety work in pm-wc1r. Byte-identical create data must not automatically authorize identity fusion. Evaluate authenticated shared-prefix recovery and actionable refusal artifacts together with the open settlement UX in pm-gh1475. Any later reproduction must use a fresh external temporary repository with isolated project/global trackers; do not replay the report in the real workspace.

Source report: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1491
